mergedParams.userDescription: Glitchy, datamosh-inspired neon text flashes that distort and reset. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Glitchy Datamosh Neon Text - Distorted Typokinetics

prompts.prompt: Create a glitchy datamosh text preset that simulates digital video compression artifacts breaking apart and reassembling. Think of it like a corrupted video file where text fragments into horizontal RGB channel separations, distorts with wave displacement, then snaps back into place. The animation should feel like classic datamosh effects from video editing - sudden tears, pixel bleeding, and harsh digital noise. Use a multi-layer approach where each word gets its own glitch timeline with randomized distortion patterns. The text should flash with neon colors (cyan, magenta, yellow) overlaid using blend modes, creating that distinctive VHS tracking error aesthetic. Include sudden frame drops where text disappears entirely for 1-2 frames, then returns displaced before correcting itself.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' containing individual TextAtom components for each word wrapped in BaseLayout divs with 'absolute' positioning. Use caption data to process word-level timing. Apply three duplicate layers per word - one for each RGB channel using 'mix-blend-screen' or 'mix-blend-multiply'. Effects: Create internal effect preset 'glitch-distortion' with keyframe animations for translateX (random -20px to 20px jumps), scaleX (0.8 to 1.2 stretches), skewX (-15deg to 15deg), and custom CSS filters for hue-rotate. Add opacity flickers (0 to 1) at irregular intervals. Use transform: translate3d() for GPU acceleration. Timing: Each word glitches for 200-400ms with 50ms reset snaps. Use 'steps(1)' easing for digital hard cuts, 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)' for elastic snaps. Set fitDurationTo: 'children' to adapt to caption length.

prompts.prompt: Design a neon text flash preset inspired by cyberpunk hologram displays that malfunction and recalibrate. Visualize text as unstable holographic projections that flicker between different color channels, experience signal interference, and occasionally 'reboot' with a bright flash. The effect should feel like looking at text through a broken CRT monitor with phosphor burn-in and scan lines. Each letter should have subtle continuous vibration (like electromagnetic interference) punctuated by major glitch events where the entire text distorts into abstract shapes before reforming. Add chromatic aberration where red and blue channels separate during distortion peaks.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex items-center justify-center bg-black' containing TextAtom components with 'relative z-10'. Create scan line overlay using ShapeAtom with repeating linear gradient. Typography: Use monospace font 'JetBrains Mono:700' for tech aesthetic. Effects: Generic keyframe effects array with continuous micro-vibration (translateX/Y ±2px at 60fps), combined with waveform effects for audio-reactive glitches if audio present. Apply CSS filters: contrast(200%) brightness(150%) during flash moments. Use text-shadow for neon glow: '0 0 10px currentColor, 0 0 20px currentColor, 0 0 40px currentColor'. Implement chromatic aberration using ::before and ::after pseudo-elements via containerProps.style. Timing: Continuous vibration throughout, major glitches every 800-1200ms lasting 100-200ms. Use 'ease-in-out' for smooth vibrations, 'steps(4)' for digital glitches.

prompts.prompt: Build a datamosh text animation that mimics compression algorithm failures where text pixels 'bleed' into adjacent frames. Picture the effect of dragging video frames in a timeline where motion vectors get confused - text should appear to smear horizontally as if previous frames are bleeding through, creating ghosting trails. The distortion should build up gradually like accumulating compression errors, then suddenly reset to clean text with a bright neon flash. Include digital artifact patterns like macroblocking where parts of text become blocky 8x8 pixel chunks.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full bg-gray-900' with multiple TextAtom layers. Main text layer plus 4-5 ghost layers with decreasing opacity (0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2, 0.1) and increasing translateX offsets. Use repeatChildrenProps to duplicate text layers efficiently. Effects: Custom CSS via containerProps.style for pixelation filter using SVG filters or CSS image-rendering: pixelated. Implement motion blur using multiple transform: translateX() values with opacity fades. Create 'pixel-bleed' internal effect with scaleX stretching to 1.5x while fading. Flash effect using backgroundColor animation from transparent to 'rgb(0, 255, 255)' with mix-blend-mode: screen. Timing: Gradual distortion build over 1000-1500ms, instant reset in 50ms, flash duration 100ms. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1)' for smooth accumulation, 'linear' for reset snap.

prompts.prompt: Create a kinetic typography preset where text behaves like it's being transmitted through damaged fiber optic cables - data packets arriving out of order, reassembling, corrupting, and retransmitting. Each word should 'download' with a staggered glitch effect, displaying random characters/symbols briefly before resolving to the correct text. Include neon color shifts that pulse through the electromagnetic spectrum (violet to red) during transmission errors. The animation should feel like watching a live stream with severe packet loss - stuttering, freezing, then catching up rapidly.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-max gap-2' for word spacing. Each word in separate BaseLayout with TextAtom child. Implement character scrambling using multiple TextAtom overlays with different text content, rapidly switching visibility. Caption data drives word-by-word reveal timing. Effects: Use generic effects for rapid opacity toggles (0 to 1) creating strobe effect. Color shifts via CSS filter: hue-rotate() animating from 0deg to 360deg. Add data corruption effect with random Unicode characters (█▓▒░) replacing text temporarily. Implement using childrenProps with unique IDs for targeted effects. Timing: Each word takes 300-500ms to 'download', with 50-100ms scramble phase. Stagger words by 100ms using caption word timings. Use 'steps(8)' for digital stepping, 'ease-out' for final resolution.

prompts.prompt: Develop a glitch text effect inspired by analog video synthesis and circuit bending - where electrical signals create beautiful chaos. Text should warp and bend as if magnetic fields are distorting the display, with waves of distortion rolling through letters like oscilloscope patterns. Include bright neon 'voltage spikes' where random letters suddenly overexpose to white before returning. The overall feel should be organic glitching rather than digital - smooth sine wave distortions mixed with sudden electrical surges. Add subtle RGB splitting that increases during peak distortion moments.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' with TextAtom using 'text-6xl font-black'. Apply SVG filters for wave distortion via containerProps.style. Create RGB split using three TextAtom layers with 'absolute inset-0' positioning, each with different blend modes (screen, multiply, overlay). Effects: Implement wave distortion using transform: matrix() with sine wave calculations or CSS custom properties for wave animation. Voltage spikes using filter: brightness(500%) contrast(200%) with immediate falloff. Add continuous slight rotation (-2deg to 2deg) for electrical instability. Use internal effect preset 'wave-distortion' with parameters for amplitude and frequency. Timing: Wave cycles every 2000ms, voltage spikes randomly every 500-800ms lasting 50ms. Use 'cubic-bezier(0.45, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)' for organic wave motion, 'ease-in' for voltage buildup, 'ease-out' for discharge.

prompts.prompt: Design a datamosh preset that recreates the aesthetic of corrupted video codecs where I-frames and P-frames desynchronize. Text should fragment into temporal echoes - previous and future states of the animation bleeding into the present frame. Create a 'time smear' effect where letters stretch across time, leaving motion trails that glitch between different temporal positions. Include harsh digital noise bursts where text completely dissolves into random pixel data before reconstituting. The neon colors should strobe between complementary pairs (cyan/red, magenta/green, yellow/blue) creating retinal burn effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative overflow-hidden' containing a timeline of 5-7 TextAtom instances representing different temporal states. Use absolute positioning with varying z-index for layering. Implement motion trails using transform: scaleX() combined with opacity gradients. Effects: Create 'temporal-echo' internal effect with staggered animations offset by -100ms to +100ms from main timeline. Digital noise using CSS backdrop-filter: blur() and contrast() with rapid value changes. Color strobing via alternating color and backgroundColor properties between complementary pairs. Add grain overlay using ShapeAtom with noise texture. Timing: Main glitch cycle every 1200ms, with micro-glitches every 200-300ms. Temporal echoes offset by 50-150ms. Use 'steps(3)' for frame-like jumping, 'linear' for continuous trails.

prompts.prompt: Build a kinetic text animation that simulates a neon sign experiencing power surges and electrical failures. Text should flicker like failing neon tubes - some letters staying lit while others strobe, dim, or completely fail. Include the characteristic neon 'warm up' where letters gradually brighten from dim orange to bright cyan/magenta. Add electrical arcing effects where bright white flashes jump between letters like short circuits. The datamosh aspect comes from digital interference patterns overlaying the analog neon effect - scan lines, pixel sorting, and compression artifacts.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'bg-black p-8' with individual TextAtom per letter wrapped in BaseLayout for independent animation control. Use 'inline-block' for letter spacing preservation. Apply neon glow using multiple text-shadow layers with increasing blur radius. Effects: Implement flickering using rapid opacity changes (0, 0.3, 1) with random patterns per letter. Warm-up effect via color animation from 'rgb(255, 100, 0)' to final neon color over 500ms. Electrical arcs using absolutely positioned ShapeAtom divs with white gradient, scale and opacity animations. Digital interference via CSS filter combinations: blur(), brightness(), contrast(). Add scan lines using ::before with repeating linear gradient. Timing: Random flicker intervals 100-400ms per letter. Warm-up staggered by 50ms per letter. Arc effects triggered every 2-3 seconds lasting 100ms. Use 'steps(2)' for hard flicker, 'ease-in' for warm-up glow.

prompts.prompt: Create a text preset that emulates video feedback loops where signal feeds back into itself creating infinite recursion glitches. Text should appear to fall into itself, creating nested copies that distort and merge. Think of pointing a camera at its own monitor - the infinite tunnel effect but with digital corruption. Each recursion level should have different distortion: scaling, rotation, color shift, and transparency. Include moments where the feedback loop 'breaks' causing all text to scatter explosively before reforming. Add datamosh-style compression artifacts that increase with each recursion level.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with perspective: 1000px containing nested BaseLayout divs creating depth layers. Each recursion level uses transform: translateZ() for 3D positioning. Generate 8-10 recursion levels using repeatChildrenProps with decreasing scale and increasing blur. TextAtom at each level with different opacity (1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4...). Effects: Apply transform-style: preserve-3d for true 3D recursion. Each level rotates slightly (rotateY ±5deg) creating spiral effect. Color shift using filter: hue-rotate() increasing by 30deg per level. Explosion effect using transform: scale(3) translateZ(500px) with opacity: 0. Compression artifacts via CSS filter: contrast() and brightness() degrading per level. Timing: Continuous slow rotation (360deg over 10s), explosion every 3-4s lasting 400ms, reformation over 600ms. Use 'linear' for endless rotation, 'cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)' for explosive scatter.

prompts.prompt: Develop a glitch typography preset inspired by broken LCD displays and dead pixels. Text should have clusters of 'stuck' pixels that flash random colors, creating a damaged screen aesthetic. Include liquid crystal bleeding effects where colors leak between letter boundaries like damaged LCD fluid. The animation should simulate display driver failures - entire rows or columns of text suddenly shifting, inverting colors, or displaying garbage data. Add the characteristic LCD 'ghosting' where previous text states remain faintly visible. Incorporate neon color bands that sweep across the text like display refresh errors.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout 'relative bg-gray-950' with grid-based pixel simulation. Overlay TextAtom with ShapeAtom grid creating pixel mask effect. Use CSS Grid 'grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, 4px)' for pixel grid. Dead pixels as absolutely positioned ShapeAtom divs with random colors. Effects: LCD bleeding using CSS filter: blur() with directional bias via transform: scaleX(1.2). Display driver failures using transform: translateX(100%) for row shifts, filter: invert() for color inversion. Ghosting via multiple TextAtom layers with opacity: 0.1 and slight position offsets. Color bands using linear-gradient overlays animated with translateY. Implement 'lcd-damage' internal effect combining multiple distortion types. Timing: Pixel flashing at 60-120ms intervals, row/column shifts every 1-2s lasting 200ms, color bands sweep in 800ms. Use 'steps(1)' for instant pixel changes, 'ease-in-out' for smooth bands.

prompts.prompt: Design a kinetic text effect that mimics real-time video stream corruption during live broadcasting. Text should experience buffering stutters, resolution drops, and bitrate fluctuations. Create the effect of adaptive streaming where quality degrades and recovers - text becoming pixelated, then sharp, then pixelated again. Include frame duplication glitches where text appears to freeze and stack multiple times before jumping forward. Add aggressive compression artifacts like color banding and macroblock distortion. The neon aesthetic comes through in error state colors - bright warning yellows, error reds, and system blues flashing during corruption peaks.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containing quality level variants of TextAtom (high-res, mid-res, low-res). Use CSS image-rendering and filter properties to simulate quality degradation. Implement frame stacking using multiple duplicate TextAtom layers with 'absolute' positioning and slight offsets. Effects: Resolution changes via dynamic font-size adjustments and filter: blur() values. Bitrate artifacts using CSS filter: contrast() and posterize effects. Frame duplication by rapidly toggling visibility of stacked layers. Color banding via reduced color palette using CSS filters. Warning colors flash using backgroundColor animations with 'mix-blend-difference'. Create 'stream-corruption' preset with parameters for corruption intensity. Timing: Quality fluctuations every 500-1500ms, frame freezes lasting 200-400ms, color flashes 100ms. Use 'steps(4)' for quality level changes, 'cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)' for smooth degradation.
